style: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: an English vocabulary learning illustration. Contemporary editorial illustration with realistic material details, bright natural light, warm cream, sage and muted blue accents. Show a specific action or object unmistakably, not a generic household icon. Adults share domestic work across genders. Clear focal point, anatomically plausible hands and tools. No text, logos, lettering or watermark. Word cards: landscape 4:3 with all action-defining details inside the central area. Overview: wide landscape scene.

scenes.title: Cleaning & Surfaces
scenes.overview: Two adult flatmates cleaning a bright living room: one vacuuming a rug and one wiping a table. A broom, dustpan and mop stored at the side. Wide believable domestic scene, no montage.
cards: wipe
Close view of a hand sliding a damp folded cloth across a kitchen table, gathering a small visible coffee spill. Gentle flat wiping action, no brush.
scrub
Close view of a gloved adult hand pressing a stiff bristle brush against dirty bathroom grout, lifting stubborn dirt with visible suds. Vigorous targeted scrubbing, no cloth.
sweep
Adult using a long-handled broom to gather dry crumbs into a small pile on a tiled floor, broom bristles touching floor.
mop
Adult moving a wet flat mop across a kitchen tile floor, damp cleaned trail visible and a bucket beside them. No broom.
vacuum
Adult using a vacuum cleaner floor head over a rug with a few crumbs, hose attached to canister visible. Entire tool action clear.
dust
Hand using a soft dry cloth to lift visible grey dust from a wooden shelf, leaving a clean streak. No water or suds.
polish
Hands buffing a wooden tabletop with a soft cloth until the wood reflects the window softly, dull and glossy portions visibly distinct. No sanding tools.
stain
Close view of a dry dark coffee stain soaked into a cream upholstery cushion, irregular brown ring and fabric fibres visible. No fresh liquid pool.
grime
Close view of a neglected kitchen extractor hood edge coated with built-up sticky grey-brown grease and dirt, clearly accumulated grime, not a single spill.
spotless
A freshly cleaned bathroom sink and chrome tap, entirely free of dust spots stains and clutter, natural bright reflections, no cartoon sparkles.

scenes.title: Laundry & Care
scenes.overview: Bright utility room with an adult sorting a laundry basket while another folds clean towels; washing machine and drying rack visible. Wide coherent scene.
cards: laundry
A fabric basket full of worn shirts socks and towels beside an open washing machine, clearly clothes awaiting washing.
detergent
Close view of a hand pouring liquid laundry detergent from a plain unbranded bottle into a measuring cap beside a washing machine drawer. No other chemicals.
soak
A stained cotton shirt fully resting in a basin of still soapy water, hands gently submerging the fabric. No running tap.
rinse
Hands holding a soapy small cloth under a stream of clean tap water, soap bubbles washing away toward the drain. Water contact clearly visible.
wring out
Two hands twisting opposite ends of a wet cloth above a basin, visible water squeezing out of the middle. Hands and twisted fabric clearly readable.
hang out
Adult pinning a freshly washed shirt onto an outdoor clothesline using clothes pegs, laundry basket nearby. Full action visible.
tumble-dry
A tumble dryer with clean towels visible through its circular glass door, a person selecting a drying control, no water and no detergent.
iron
Close view of an adult guiding a clothes iron across a wrinkled cotton shirt on an ironing board, fabric visibly smooth behind it. Cable away from hot soleplate.
fold
Two hands folding a dry towel into a neat rectangle on a table, other folded towels stacked beside it.
crease
Macro view of a cotton shirt with a sharp unwanted fold line across the front, side light makes the crease clear, no decorative pleats.

scenes.title: Kitchen Tasks
scenes.overview: Two adults finishing kitchen chores after a meal, one placing plates in the dishwasher and another clearing the table; organised cupboards and recycling containers in the background.
cards: wash up
An adult washing a used dinner plate with a sponge in a kitchen sink containing soapy water, a few dirty dishes wait beside it.
load
Hands placing a dirty plate upright into a dishwasher rack with several other dirty plates. Action clearly into the machine, not taking out.
unload
Hands lifting a clean plate from an open dishwasher towards a neat stack of clean plates on the worktop. Clear outward action.
drain
A tilted colander containing freshly rinsed vegetables over a sink, water dripping through its small holes. No boiling pot or steam.
leftovers
Small portions of cooked rice and vegetables remaining after a meal being transferred from serving dishes into storage containers. Modest amounts, not fresh meal preparation.
airtight
Close-up of a food storage box with a visible rubber sealing gasket and four side clips fastened firmly around its lid, dry cereal inside.
defrost
An unplugged empty freezer with its door open, melting ice on the interior wall and a tray and towels collecting drips. No knives, heaters or electrical repair.
wipe down
Adult methodically wiping the whole kitchen worktop with a broad cloth after a meal, crumbs being gathered, no focused stubborn stain.
clear the table
Adult lifting used plates and empty glasses from a dining table after a meal toward a tray, cleared space obvious.
take out the rubbish
Adult carrying a tied household rubbish bag out of the back door towards a large outdoor bin, no scattered litter.

scenes.title: Tidying & Storage
scenes.overview: Adult flatmates organising a living room with storage baskets, sorting books on shelves and placing unused items in a donation box. Warm realistic home scene.
cards: clutter
A home desk crowded with tangled cables scattered papers empty mugs and miscellaneous small objects, little usable surface left.
declutter
An adult removing unused objects from an overcrowded shelf into a donation box; a section of the shelf is now clear. No rubbish heap.
sort out
Adult separating a mixed pile of household items into distinct groups of cables stationery and batteries on a table.
put away
Adult placing a board game back into its proper shelf space, other games neatly stored and clear floor beneath.
stack
Hands placing one storage box squarely on top of two others to form a stable vertical stack, all box bases aligned.
storage
Open household cupboard with built-in shelves baskets and boxes holding blankets and supplies, clear usable storage space.
label
Close view of a hand attaching a blank adhesive paper label to the front of an opaque storage box. No lettering visible.
drawer divider
Top-down view inside a desk drawer with physical divider compartments separating pens cables and small stationery, boundaries unmistakable.
donate
Adult handing a box of clean usable household items to another adult at a community collection table, friendly exchange with other donation boxes visible.
recycle
Adult placing an empty clean metal drinks can into a recycling container holding other cans; nearby separate container with flattened cardboard, no text or logos.

scenes.title: Upkeep & Routines
scenes.overview: Household weekend upkeep: an adult repairing a loose cabinet handle while another checks a household task chart at a table with shopping supplies. No legible writing, bright coherent domestic scene.
cards: chore
Two adults sharing everyday household chores in one room, one folds laundry while the other tidies shelves, simple realistic activity.
rota
Two adults pointing at a weekly household task grid on a fridge, coloured rows alternate between their portrait magnets and small illustrated cleaning tasks. No words or numbers.
errand
Adult returning home carrying a parcel and a small bag of groceries, keys in hand by the front door, mundane practical trip not holiday travel.
maintenance
Adult inspecting and tightening a loose cabinet hinge with a screwdriver, keeping existing furniture in working order, not constructing new furniture.
leak
Clear droplets escaping from the joint of a pipe beneath a kitchen sink into a catching bucket, water source and wet joint clearly visible.
tighten
Close-up of a hand turning a screwdriver on a loose screw attaching a cupboard handle, other hand steadies the handle, no electrical components.
replace
Hands removing a worn felt pad from a chair leg and positioning a new intact felt pad beside it, old versus new clearly different.
mend
Close-up hands sewing a small tear in a cloth shopping bag with needle and thread, repaired stitches visible, careful natural grip.
restock
Adult adding new toilet paper rolls to a nearly empty household supply shelf, remaining space and new supply package clearly visible.
run out of
Adult tipping an empty washing powder box over an empty measuring cup, looking at the empty container, only a tiny last dusting falls. No text or branding.
